F2 omits the affine-overlap separation condition from the claimed equivalence. Gluing two copies of A^1 along G_m gives an integral finite-type scheme whose overlap ring k[t,t^-1] is not the image of k[t] tensor_k k[t], so it violates that condition. The rejection is correct, but nonfatal to this proof: X and Y are already classical varieties and their associated schemes satisfy the condition. Restored it in F2 and made the algebraically closed base explicit; no mathematical conclusion or proof step changes.

The quotient condition is exactly trace zero, while the localization condition excludes no B because 1+epsilon tr(B) has explicit inverse. F1 transfers the derivation vector-space structure, including n=1. F3 now matches its definition, F4 supplies the affine correspondence, and the existing contract and page claims remain licensed. This is an author-level check of the repair, not independent review.

Finite generation and clearing both coefficient denominators and localization torsion give nonzero H with Omega_{S/R}[1/H] generated by r elements. Intersecting D(H) with both regular loci is nonempty by irreducibility and dominance. The case r=0 uses the empty generating family. F2 now matches the supplier and existing contract; AC remains declared. This checks the authored repair, not an independent rejudgment.
